children: Sweden life science firm's Q2 net sales more than doubled yr/yr but growth lagged plans
Operating loss widened in Q2, reflecting higher costs and Dutch operations consolidation
Company secured new Swedish contracts, a European patent, and ISO/IEC 27001 certification
iZafe Group maintains forecast of 22.5 MSEK in ARR at end-2026, requiring accelerated installations
Company focus for H2 2026 is converting agreements and opportunities into more recurring revenues and improved cash flow
Company adapting production planning to address component lead times and support future growth
PRODUCTION DELAYS - Co said limited availability of Dosell units and longer customer processes postponed planned installations, slowing revenue growth
HIGHER COSTS - Operating loss widened due to increased costs from Dutch operations consolidation, organizational reinforcements and expanded sales and marketing activities
SCALING-UP INVESTMENTS - Co invested in production and commercial capacity ahead of expected revenue growth, but revenues have not yet caught up with scaling-up efforts
